# telnyx_storage_sql_databases (Data Source)

Lists storage sql databases, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_storage_sql_database`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String)
- `filter_status` (String) One of `delete_failed`, `deleting`, `pending`, `provision_failed`, `provision_ok`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) One of `-created_at`, `-name`, `-status`, `created_at`, `name`, `status`.

### Read-Only

- `storage_sql_databases` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_sql_databases))

<a id="nestedatt--storage_sql_databases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_sql_databases`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `record_type` (String)
- `status` (String) Provisioning status. A database is usable once `status` is `provision_ok`. Once deletion completes, the database no longer appears in the API.
- `updated_at` (String)
